decls.name: Fact215ConjugatePrimePairs

paper_span.quote: Hence the fixed rational primes give \(m=tf\) conjugate pairs of prime ideals of \(K\):

decls.rationale: Formalizes the setup fact of Section 2: each \(q_b\) splits completely in `L` and \(q_b \equiv 1 \pmod 4\), so the `t` rational primes produce exactly \(m = tf\) conjugate pairs \(\{\mathfrak{P}_s, c\mathfrak{P}_s\}\) — i.e. `2 * t * f` primes of `K` over the `q_b`.
